description: Writes and maintains a game's design docs: a one-page GDD with a feature index and short feature notes, kept true to the code by a link and status checker. Use for "draft a GDD", "spec out this mechanic", or updating docs after a playtest or code change. Not for building a game when no docs were asked for (`prototype-fast`, `game-jam`), READMEs or level layouts (`level-design`).
